notes:
A big release: a redesigned composer with model, sources and connector controls, guided setup, an opt-in canary channel, and a long list of stability fixes across sessions, updates and sandboxing.

### New

- **Model picker** — pick the model, reasoning effort and provider from a single chip in the composer.
- **Sources** — a popover showing exactly which folders the agent can read and write, and a matching sandbox for Codex.
- **Connectors** — a dedicated control in the composer for the tools and services the agent can reach.
- **Context meter** — see how much of the model's context window the conversation has used.
- **Guided setup** — a setup assistant walks you through getting Palette ready, with a simpler agent step in Quickstart.
- **Canary channel** — opt in to nightly builds of the next release, and see which build you're on.
- **Reveal in file tree** — jump from an open file to its place in Palette's own file tree.
- **Unified diffs** — file changes now render as a familiar GitHub-style side-by-side view.
- **Review folder updates** — see what changed in a folder before it lands in your work.
- **Shared HTML in Organisational context** — HTML files shared with you now show up alongside the rest.
- **Palette documentation built in** — agents can look up Palette's own docs without any setup.

### Improved

- **New app frame** — a floating-card window with an inset toolbar, plus a polished drag-to-Applications installer.
- **Files in chat** — attachments are grouped into a single card with proper elevation instead of loose pills.
- **Zero-install agents** — enabling an agent installs its CLI for you, and Palette checks for runtime updates on launch.
- **Read-only Drive folders** — Palette tells you a folder is read-only before you start a session in it, and refuses to publish into one.
- **Account checks** — agents show a clear checking state while Palette confirms your account.
- **Sandbox warnings** — the folder scope is enforced in every mode, and Palette warns you when a session is running unconfined.

### Fixed

- **Sidebar resize** — dragging the sidebar edge works again, and the collapsed expand icon lines up.
- **Updates** — installs no longer race each other, a staged build survives a channel switch, "update ready" reflects the build you're actually running, and a download that fails to install now says so.
- **Sessions crossing over** — each turn is routed to its own tab, so replies can't land in the wrong session.
- **Allow All and Plan on Gemini and Mistral** — both now work, and Allow All stays inside your workspace.
- **Gemini API key** — saving a key updates every open window straight away.
- **Sign-in** — a second sign-in attempt reuses the one already in progress instead of failing, and expired sessions are recognised properly.
- **Sharing** — a file used twice is uploaded once, and a rejected share explains why.
- **Session picker** — it no longer hangs when one provider fails to list its sessions.
- **File preview** — the "Viewing" marker clears when you close the preview panel.
- **Connectors** — "no connectors" is no longer confused with "still loading".
- **Codex models** — the model list is checked against the CLI Palette is actually driving.
- **Handoffs** — a handed-over session reliably arrives with its prompt in place.
- **Slack community link** — Help now points at a working invite.
